nodes.description: Expression of the extracellular-matrix proteins COL1A1, MMP1 and MMP3 is strongly reduced in cells from affected individuals. The authors attribute the syndrome to extracellular-matrix dysfunction; the link from this expression change to each connective-tissue feature is their framing rather than a measured step. The GO term extracellular matrix organization is a coarse stand-in for the reported reduction in COL1A1, MMP1 and MMP3 expression; MMP1 and MMP3 are matrix-remodelling enzymes rather than matrix components.
